featured_reviews.name: Nilima Humbre
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with the service at this Wellness Forever branch and would like to warn other customers about my experience.

I have been ordering medicines from this store for more than 2 years. Recently, I have been facing repeated service issues from this particular branch.

On 04-06-2026 at around 8:23 PM, I called the store as I usually do to place an order. I shared my prescription details, contact number, and delivery address. The staff confirmed that the medicine was available in stock and assured me that it would be delivered.

However, even after 24 hours, nobody called me or updated me regarding the order. When I called back on 05-06-2026 at around 8:55 PM to check the status, I was shocked to be informed that no order had been placed at all.

To make matters worse:

• The staff could not locate my prescription.
• The staff was unable to identify the medicine correctly and repeatedly mentioned the wrong medicine name.
• The staff kept asking me to send the details again on WhatsApp despite already having shared everything earlier.

This level of negligence is completely unacceptable, especially when dealing with medicines that customers may urgently require. Wellness Forever is a well-known brand, but the poor service and lack of staff competency at this branch are seriously damaging its reputation.

I request Wellness Forever management to take strict action and provide proper training to the staff of this branch.

I would also advise fellow customers to be cautious while ordering medicines from this branch. The staff appears incapable of handling orders accurately, which may lead to delays or confusion regarding medicines. Additionally, the delivery service is extremely slow and, in my experience, orders are rarely delivered early minimum 2 hours to deliver at a 10 mins location.

Very disappointing experience.
